cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The Data Protection Act allows transfers abroad only to approved countries [BWA-002], which answers question 1. The same report says a copy must stay in Botswana, so openness is not shown and the stage is 2. An adequacy list is reported [BWA-001].
